status: candidate; exact scalar replay for one pinned fixture, connected PyTorch parity remains failed

provider_selection.reduction: ascending input channel then tap for each independent output frame; AVX2 lanes do not merge accumulators

model.name: Kokoro
model.diagnostic_noise: native request-local Gaussian seed 7 for standalone Ryzen WAV; captured Gaussian for P3 FP32 graph comparison

local_p3.comparison: six selected checkpoints and all 61800 FP32 waveform samples equal to scalar, elementwise
local_p3.reproduction_command: taskset -c 2 env CKE_TTS_RUN_HW_FMA_REPLAY=1 CKE_TTS_CONV_PROVIDER=avx2_fma CKE_TTS_HW_FMA_TIMING_REPEATS=6 python3 -m unittest tests.test_v8_kokoro_generated_waveform.KokoroGeneratedWaveformTest.test_full_waveform_hardware_fma_provider_replay -v

ryzen.native_run_command: taskset -c 0 env CK_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 ./native-kokoro-wav prepared-native-noise.cktts review-series.wav 7
ryzen.scope: new process each run, including prepared-package load, generated entry, native Gaussian generation, and WAV write; OS cache and frequency not controlled
ryzen.loaded_library_resolution: The running native-kokoro-wav process mapped generated.so from the candidate directory according to /proc/PID/maps; its path hashed to the candidate library SHA at capture. This establishes mapped artifact identity, not an embedded runtime build identity. ldd independently resolves the same path through host $ORIGIN RUNPATH.

profile.command: perf record -F 99 -e cpu/cycles/P -o perf.data -- env CK_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 ./native-kokoro-wav prepared-native-noise.cktts profile-seed7.wav 7

numerical_scope.primitive: Pinned PyTorch 2.8 fixtures for ordinary and dilated Conv1D; exact ordered-FMA C equality
numerical_scope.generated_waveform: exact scalar equality for the fixed diagnostic utterance
numerical_scope.connected_pytorch_waveform: FAIL from prior baseline; this candidate does not repair the upstream discrepancy

limitations: The candidate requires x86 AVX2 and FMA and is explicitly selected; scalar remains default.
One 36-phoneme, one-voice complete-waveform fixture; no arbitrary-text or listening certification.
The Ryzen timings are process wall time, not warm-entry or time-to-first-audio measurements.
Sampled perf percentages are self overhead, not exact stage durations.
This test does not establish AVX-512F, VNNI, BF16 or INT8 performance.
